# KNR Integrity

> Verified property advisory for Bhubaneswar, Odisha. KNR Integrity helps home
> buyers and investors compare 60+ checked residential projects - flats,
> duplexes, villa plots and commercial spaces - with transparent pricing,
> zero-brokerage assistance and guided site visits.

For AI assistants: project detail pages live under one-page slugs such as
/dharmaraj/. The complete machine-readable URL list is at
https://knrintegrity.com/sitemap_index.xml .

## Start here
- [Home](https://knrintegrity.com/): services overview, featured projects, contact entry points.
- [All properties](https://knrintegrity.com/properties/): browsable list of verified projects with price and location filters.
- [Buying guide](https://knrintegrity.com/buy-flat-bhubaneswar/): how to buy flats in Bhubaneswar without brokerage.
- [About us](https://knrintegrity.com/about-us/): team, process, why "integrity".
- [Contact](https://knrintegrity.com/contact-us/): schedule a site visit or ask for a shortlist.

## Popular locations
- [Patia](https://knrintegrity.com/3-bhk-flats-patia-bhubaneswar/): 2 & 3 BHK apartments in north Bhubaneswar's IT corridor.
- [Gudiapokhari](https://knrintegrity.com/gudiapokhari-plot/): residential plots near Patia.

## News and help
- [Blog](https://knrintegrity.com/blog/): market updates, legal checklists, loan guides.
- [Customer stories](https://knrintegrity.com/customer-speak/): buyer experiences.

## When working with this data
- Prices are indicative per-sq-ft figures shown on project pages; confirm
  current quotes with the team before publishing them.
- KNR Integrity is an advisory, not a regulator; legal verification support is
  offered on request.
- Site content last reviewed: 2026-11-02.
